location_app.purpose: Primary customer-facing HighLevel connector. Cloudy operates the authorized HighLevel Location/Sub-Account from CloudSales and the CloudSales PWA.

agency_app.purpose: Separate agency-level connector for agency resources and future Agency Pro capabilities.
agency_app.portal_status: not confirmed visible in current My Apps; create/configure separately after the main CloudSales app if needed

architecture.control_model: CloudSales is the product and PWA. Cloudy is the primary operator and automation executor. AgentCloud is limited to AI conversations and calls. HighLevel and other CRMs are connected infrastructure behind CloudSales.

billing.unknown_cost_behavior: reconcile rather than invent a charge

marketplace_subscription_flow: HighLevel redirects installer to https://cloudsales.app/subscribe with clientId/installType/locationId/companyId.
CloudSales validates the HighLevel client ID server-side and creates an embedded Stripe subscription checkout with a 7-day trial and payment method required.
Marketplace context is stored server-side with the Stripe checkout session.
After checkout, https://cloudsales.app/welcome calls the server-side HighLevel billing bridge.
The bridge validates the completed Stripe session and authorizes the paid installation through HighLevel's external billing webhook.
A transactional CloudSales access email is queued, immediate Email Engine delivery is attempted, and the member is directed to https://app.cloudsales.app/?welcome=1.
Marketplace, website and PWA use the same CloudSales plan, member identity, workspace, terms and usage policy.

email_delivery.current_external_blocker: Resend API returned HTTP 401 during domain provisioning on 2026-09-02; the stored Resend credential must be replaced or restored before Marketplace welcome email delivery can be verified end-to-end. Checkout, HighLevel billing authorization and PWA redirect do not depend on email delivery.

roles.cloudy: Primary operator: work, orchestration, automations and authorized execution.

scope_policy.product_goal: Cloudy should be able to perform essentially every operational action a customer may reasonably delegate inside HighLevel.
scope_policy.review_constraint: HighLevel requires least privilege and scope justification. Request broad operational read/write scopes that map to real CloudSales/Cloudy features; exclude only scopes with no defensible product use.
scope_policy.portal_persistence_issue: Scopes selected in the current Android Chrome Desktop Site session have not reliably persisted. Verify persistence before re-selecting the complete set.

current_portal_blockers: Persist OAuth scopes in HighLevel Developer Portal.
Confirm CloudSales User Production Client Key is recognized by the draft.
Set app business model to Paid and enable External Billing with Billing URL https://cloudsales.app/subscribe if not already configured.
Register the HighLevel lifecycle/operational webhook endpoint.
Run a real Marketplace sandbox/test installation and verify OAuth, billing authorization, PWA access and webhooks.
external_non_portal_blockers: Restore a valid Resend API credential and complete cloudsales.app sender-domain verification for automatic Marketplace access-email delivery.
